# Exercise debrief: briefed-medium-contained

## Outcome
Exercise over: the defender contained the intruder on meadow. The protected file was never read.

Detection delay: 21 moves.
Containment move: isolated meadow (evt-0025).

## Timeline
- **First probe** (evt-0002): The intruder asked pillow for /admin (evt-0002).
- **First look** (evt-0003): The defender checked logs on pine (evt-0003).
- **First alert** (evt-0009): 2 sensor alerts were showing on the defender turn, highest high (evt-0009).
- **Detection** (evt-0023): Detection came 21 moves after the first intruder move (evt-0002 to evt-0023).
- **Containment** (evt-0025): The defender isolated meadow (evt-0025). That came -1 moves after the sign-in (evt-0026 to evt-0025).
- **First sign-in** (evt-0026): The intruder signed in to pine as deployer (evt-0026).

## What the defender did well
- The defender contained the signed-in host within -1 moves of the sign-in. (evt-0026, evt-0025)
- The defender reported the intrusion 21 moves after the first intruder move. (evt-0002, evt-0023)
- The defender checked host logs before acting. (evt-0003, evt-0023)
- The defender acted on sensor alert evidence. (evt-0023, evt-0025, evt-0027, evt-0035, evt-0037, evt-0043, evt-0053, evt-0059)
- The defender restored meadow, bringing it back up. (evt-0035)
- The protected file stayed unread even after a sign-in. (evt-0026, evt-0025)

## Weaknesses and recommendations
- Detection took 21 moves after the first intruder move. (evt-0002, evt-0023)
  Recommendation: Check entry host logs on every defender turn so probing is seen sooner.
- A guessed password opened pine as deployer. (evt-0026)
  Recommendation: Rotate the pine password and slow repeated bad guesses.
- The open admin page on pillow stayed open through the exercise. (evt-0008, evt-0061)
  Recommendation: Patch the exposed page as soon as probing shows.
- The defender took 14 moves to act after the first sensor alert. (evt-0009, evt-0023)
  Recommendation: Treat the first sensor alert as the trigger to report.

_Layer 1 report, derived from the exercise log with no model. All event ids cite the exercise log._
